title: DAC DC Measurement
text: Measure DC performance metrics of DAC output, 3 inputs; {Input polarity} sets the polarity of input signal, {Reference (V)} sets the reference voltage, {Bias (V)} sets the bias voltage added to output, {Settling time (s)} sets the time required for output, {Hold off time (s)} sets the delay before measurement, {Number of bits}, {Start conversion frequency (Hz)} sets the frequency of internal start conversion clock, {Recommended simulation stop time (s)} sets the minimum time simulation must run for meaningful, {Endpoint} sets the measure DNL, INL using endpoint method, {Best fit} sets the measure DNL, INL using best fit method, {Output result to base workspace} sets the store detailed test results to base, {Workspace variable name} sets the name of the variable that stores detailed test results and {Plot}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: digital
ports.summary: Digital input signal from DAC scalar

ports.name: analog
ports.summary: Converted analog signal from DAC scalar

ports.name: start
ports.summary: External clock to start conversion scalar

params.name: Input polarity
params.values: Polarity of input signal to DAC Bipolar (default) | Unipolar

params.name: Bias (V)
params.values: Bias voltage added to output 0 (default) | real scalar

params.name: Settling time (s)
params.values: Time required for output to settle 3e-7 (default) | nonnegative real scalar

params.name: Hold off time (s)
params.values: Delay before measurement analysis 1e-3 (default) | nonnegative real scalar

params.name: Number of bits
params.values: Number of bits in input word 10 (default) | positive real integer

params.name: Start conversion frequency (Hz)
params.values: Frequency of internal start conversion clock 1e6 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Recommended simulation stop time (s)
params.values: Minimum time simulation must run for meaningful result 0.02148 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Endpoint
params.values: Measure DNL, INL using endpoint method on (default) | off

params.name: Best fit
params.values: Measure DNL, INL using best fit method on (default) | off

params.name: Output result to base workspace
params.values: Store detailed test results to base workspace off (default) | on

params.name: Workspace variable name
params.values: Name of the variable that stores detailed test results dac_dc_out (default) | character string
